title: (dev 3.1.1.2) Bug in Preferences from AutoISF-Plugin
symptom: The value of 'variable SMB delivery ratio. mapped glucose range' changes automatically to a very high value, if you set value <39. To reproduce the error, please enter a value <39 and exit the settings. When you call up the settings again, the high value will be displayed.
cause: It looks like it converts the entered range from mmol/l to mg/dl.
fix: Until clarified/solved enter those 'smaller' ranges as mmol/L numbers without actually selecting mmol/L as your units.
evidence_quote: It Looks like it converts the entered range from mmol/l to mg/dl
